OBJECTIVE
· to investigate possible changes in the aryl hydrocarbon monooxygenase (AHM) ac- tivity in rat
lungs, kidneys, and liver
following a 3-week glycerol inhalation in or- der to answer the following questions:

- Is glycerol an inducer of monooxygenase reactions?
